card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, about, if, avoid, 's) right after words of fear, secrecy or evasion, just before a phrase about reporting, speaking out or being found out.

modes.label: Inside secrets or exposure clauses
modes.description: Small words inside a clause about information being read, aired or passed to authorities.
